name: Policy file guard
summary: Stop an agent from silently weakening existing quality and ownership policy files.
description: A Claude Code PreToolUse gate for Write and Edit that protects existing lint, format, dependency, and ownership configuration from in-session modification.
risk_reason: This automatic gate stops an agent from silently weakening existing quality and ownership policy files; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not decide that a policy change is legitimate on the agent's behalf.
It does not modify protected configuration or expose agent-writable exceptions.
It does not inspect or block files outside the active project root.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate structured runtime input and deterministically allow or block the guarded operation.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to stop an agent from silently weakening existing quality and ownership policy files without deferred work.
